name: Gary Stu
source:
Eldest son and heir of an old European noble wizard family, he has been raised in wealth and privilege. Now he wants the chance for a fresh start. That was why he chose to become an exchange student in the distant land of Vermont, in the United States of America. 

[Edited from [url=https://hanakogames.itch.io/magical-diary-wolf-hall]itch.io[/url]]
